papers.title_en: KnowledgeClaw: Towards Agentic Knowledge Engineering via Omnimodal Hypergraphs
papers.authors: Haoran Luo, Jiapu Wang, Linhao Luo, Luu Anh Tuan
papers.evidence: 构建全模态类型化超图知识库并结合图检索增强生成的智能体化知识工程
papers.tldr: 现有知识工程系统难以同时满足全模态、闭环生命周期与多粒度应用，且缺少统一评测。为此，作者形式化OmniKE并发布OmniKE-Bench，含六项任务、1829个无模型条目与3960个真实文件。提出的KnowledgeClaw构建全模态类型超图，以闭环生命周期智能体维护更新，并按查询路由到合适粒度。在30个基线中六项任务均第一，OKE达55.9，较最强基线高14.6。
papers.abstract_en: Knowledge engineering (KE) turns raw files into a reasoning-ready knowledge base, a task now within reach of LLM agents. KE has progressed from chunk and graph retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to memory agents, agentic KE and multimodal KE. However, a live knowledge base needs omnimodality, a closed-loop lifecycle and multi-granular application at once, yet existing systems meet at most two and no benchmark measures all three. We formalize Omnimodal Knowledge Engineering (OmniKE) and release OmniKE-Bench, six tasks with 1,829 model-free items over 3,960 real files in five modalities. We further propose KnowledgeClaw, an agentic system that builds an omnimodal typed hypergraph, keeps it current with a closed-loop lifecycle agent and routes each query to the granularity it needs. Against 30 baselines, it ranks first on all six tasks with an overall OKE of 55.9, +14.6 over the strongest baseline. Our software and data are publicly available at https://github.com/LHRLAB/KnowledgeClaw.

papers.title_en: AutoOntic: Automatic Ontology Induction from Text for Knowledge Graph Construction
papers.authors: Alla Chepurova, Aydar Bulatov, Mikhail Burtsev, Yuri Kuratov
papers.evidence: 通过本体归纳提升GraphRAG的知识图谱质量
papers.tldr: 图检索增强生成依赖高质量知识图谱，但现有无模式LLM抽取常得到无类型层级、无域/值域约束的扁平图。AutoOntic自动规范化开放词表实体类型与关系，归纳类型层级并挖掘关系域/值域约束。在Text2KGBench两个子集上，超90%端点类型与参考类语义对齐；在MINE上检索准确率达88%。该工作为文本自动构建本体并约束KG构建提供了可复现流程。
papers.abstract_en: Graph-based retrieval-augmented generation depends on the quality of the knowledge graph (KG) it retrieves over, yet schema-free LLM-based extraction pipelines typically produce flat graphs: deduplicated entities and relations with no type hierarchy and no domain/range constraints. We present AutoOntic, a pipeline that automatically constructs an ontology from text by canonicalizing open-vocabulary entity types and relations, inducing a hierarchy over the canonicalized types, and mining relation-level domain and range constraints. Its hierarchy induction procedure prioritizes types using corpus-derived relation-argument profiles and places them through local, LLM-adjudicated parent/child checks, allowing newly inserted types to trigger reassignment of existing parent-child links. The resulting hierarchy constrains entity deduplication and supports the induction of relation-level domain/range constraints. For intrinsic evaluation, we introduce a reference-based protocol that classifies induced ontology types as exact, broader, narrower, or unrelated to reference domain and range classes. On the Wikidata-TekGen and DBpedia-WebNLG subsets of Text2KGBench, over 90% of AutoOntic's induced endpoint types are semantically aligned with the reference classes across two LLM backbones: about half match exactly, while most remaining differences concern granularity. On MINE, knowledge graphs organized using an ontology built by AutoOntic achieve 88% retrieval accuracy. AutoOntic is available at https://github.com/screemix/AutoOntic.

papers.title_en: Causals: An Open Knowledge Graph for Research on Causal Reasoning
papers.authors: Miaozhe Lin, Qiongzheng Lin, Zhongwei Liang, Zijun Liu
papers.evidence: 支持因果与多跳推理的开放知识图谱表示
papers.tldr: 将因果知识应用到新事件，需把事件与相关实体及其后果展开关系连接起来。作者构建开放知识图谱 Causals，从新闻报道抽取事件、组织、商品、金融工具等实体与关系。初始版含 369,184 个节点和 1,272,418 条边，区分结构关系、观测与归因因果主张并保留来源链接。该资源刻画连通性与多跳检索特性，为语言模型检索上下文并应用因果机制提供共享知识，并以 CC BY 4.0 开放且邀请贡献本体、记录与证据。
papers.abstract_en: Applying causal knowledge to a new event requires connecting the event to relevant entities and the relationships through which its consequences may unfold. We present Causals, an open knowledge graph for research on this form of reasoning. Its initial release, constructed from news reports, contains 369,184 nodes and 1,272,418 edges linking reported events, organizations, commodities, financial instruments, and other entities. Structural relationships, observations, and attributed causal claims retain distinct semantics and links to source records. We describe the construction and representation of the resource and characterize its connectivity and multi-hop retrieval properties. Causals provides shared relational knowledge for studying how language models retrieve relevant context and apply mechanisms to particular events. The dataset is available under CC BY 4.0 at https://causals.org/, and we invite contributions to its ontology, records, and evidence.

papers.title_en: Interactive Structured Environment Scaling for Large Language Model Agentic Reasoning
papers.authors: Peng Yu, Luoyi Fu, Xinbing Wang, Ying Wen
papers.evidence: 面向大模型智能体推理的结构化与检索环境及子图检索
papers.tldr: 现有结构化/检索环境先抽取答案附近子图或固定段落，压缩候选空间并泄露答案位置，使路径选择等并非真实策略决策。RISE把结构化强化学习扩展到全尺度交互数据库：决策空间缩放用五阶段类型意图适配器暴露未剪枝知识图谱，并以调用预算和grounding奖励门控约束；学习前沿缩放结合结构层级推进与自进化能力前沿bandit，缓解组内方差塌缩。在19个基准和3个骨干上，RISE提升域内与未见schema知识图谱推理，零样本迁移到开放域段落检索，并增强域外数学与逻辑推理。
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning via environmental interaction is a cornerstone post-training paradigm for evolving large language models into autonomous agents capable of multi-turn tool use and exploration. Because the environment defines what the policy observes and how actions are verified, its structure directly bounds the capabilities an agent can acquire. Yet existing structured and retrieval environments rely on upstream pre-filtering---extracting a compact subgraph around the gold answer or retrieving fixed passages before the policy acts. We show that such pre-filtering introduces a fundamental measurement confound: because per-question subgraphs enclose ground-truth paths, they compress the candidate space by orders of magnitude and leak answer locations via local topology, allowing a question-blind degree heuristic to surface gold answers far above chance. To restore path selection, candidate pruning, and optimal stopping as genuine policy decisions, we propose RISE (Interactive Structured Environment), which transitions structured reinforcement learning from static subgraphs to full-scale interactive databases along two coupled axes. First, Decision-Space Scaling exposes the unpruned knowledge graph via a five-stage graph-agnostic typed intent adapter under a bounded call budget and a multiplicative grounding reward gate. Second, Learning-Frontier Scaling overcomes within-group variance collapse under group-normalized objectives by uniting model-independent structural tier progression with a self-evolving competence-frontier bandit. Across nineteen benchmarks and three model backbones, RISE substantially advances in-domain and unseen-schema knowledge-graph reasoning, transfers zero-shot to open-domain passage retrieval, and significantly enhances out-of-domain mathematical and logical deduction.

papers.title_en: NaviGATE: Noise-Aware Dual-View Generation for Multimodal Knowledge Graph Reasoning
papers.authors: Jie Peng, Yongxue Shan, Yongfu Zha, Cui Miao, Xiaodong Wang
papers.evidence: 对噪声检索鲁棒的多模态知识图谱推理
papers.tldr: 多模态知识图谱推理需融合结构、文本与视觉证据，但嵌入方法表征固定，生成方法易受噪声检索干扰并产生无效实体。NaviGATE 对齐图结构与文本语义，并以多模态实体摘要和结构 token 微调语言模型，实现结构感知知识激活。其噪声感知双视图微调联合优化无检索与检索感知视图，强化可靠候选、抑制误导候选，推理时用结构约束解码限定有效实体。标准基准上它优于强基线，并在噪声检索下保持鲁棒。
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal knowledge graph reasoning (MKGR) aims to infer missing facts by jointly exploiting relational structures, textual descriptions, and visual evidence. Existing embedding-based methods effectively capture graph topology, but their fixed multimodal representations are less effective for query-specific fine-grained semantic reasoning, while generation-based methods are vulnerable to noisy retrieval and may produce invalid entities. To address these challenges, we propose NaviGATE, a noise-aware generative framework for MKGR. NaviGATE first aligns graph-derived structural representations with textual semantics, then performs structure-aware internal knowledge activation by fine-tuning the multimodal language model with multimodal entity summaries and injected structural tokens. In the noise-aware dual-view instruction tuning stage, NaviGATE jointly optimizes retrieval-free and retrieval-aware views: reliable retrieved candidates are reinforced through contrastive logit sharpening, while misleading candidates are suppressed through parametric consistency distillation. In inference, structure-constrained decoding restricts generation to valid entities in the target knowledge graph. Experiments on standard benchmarks show that NaviGATE consistently outperforms strong unimodal, multimodal, and generation-based baselines, and remains robust under noisy retrieval scenarios.

papers.title_en: Ground, Iterate, Trace: Decomposing AI Research Ideation
papers.authors: Samson Yu, Qiran Zou, Jing Yu Lim, Rushi Shah, Anirudh Goyal, Dianbo Liu
papers.evidence: 智能体构建语义知识图谱并使用图检索工具
papers.tldr: 大模型能生成看似合理的研究想法，但其有效性来源与创新如何从既有文献产生仍不清楚。CAR框架用文献语义知识图谱、图检索工具及四种概念算子进行迭代构思，并记录每步变换与文献来源。在40个LiveIdeaBench主题和两个执行基准上，CAR方法新颖性显著高于单次提示与The AI Scientist，可行性优于RIA，执行胜率最高。消融未证实显式算子稳定带来质量增益，但贡献在于将构思质量与可追踪过程分离。
papers.abstract_en: Large language models have been widely used to generate plausible research ideas, yet it remains unclear what makes automated ideation effective and how generated novel proposals arise from prior scientific work. We introduce the Creative AI Researcher (CAR), an agentic framework combining literature grounding, iterative development and explicit conceptual operators. CAR constructs a semantic knowledge graph from retrieved literature and equips an ideation agent with graph-retrieval tools and four operators: bisociation, analogy, exploration and elaboration. Each operator call is checked against structural acceptance conditions and recorded, producing a trace of intermediate transformations and declared literature sources. We evaluate CAR with two language-model backbones across 40 LiveIdeaBench research topics and two execution benchmarks. CAR achieves significantly higher methodological novelty (MN) than single-shot prompting and The AI Scientist. Its methodological novelty does not differ significantly from the Research Ideation Agent, while its feasibility scores are higher on both backbones. With a shared experiment executor, CAR achieves the highest pairwise win rate among the evaluated AI methods on FML-bench-Lite and BioXArena. In a ten-condition ablation study, MN point estimates favor CAR over one-step proposal on both backbones, but no MN contrast survives correction for multiple comparisons. The results do not establish a consistent quality benefit from explicit operators beyond free-form iteration. CAR makes the sequence of operations and declared literature sources inspectable, separating judged idea quality from procedural traceability.

papers.title_en: STARK: Moving towards Personalized Agents That Truly Learn and Remember
papers.authors: Aryan Jain, Abhishek Jha, Anish Nediyanchath, Promod Yenigalla
papers.evidence: 面向个性化智能体的双图记忆架构，存储情景与洞察知识
papers.tldr: 长时记忆对个性化智能体至关重要，但现有架构多记录“发生了什么”，把“为何发生”留给底层大模型，且用户知识彼此孤立。STARK提出双图记忆架构，将事件同时作为行为洞察的边：情节图记录时序、因果与语义关联的交互，洞察图存储大模型抽取的行为信号并由支持事件连接。推理时直接从洞察节点检索行为知识，避免重复遍历情节图，并支持跨用户迁移以缓解冷启动。实验在LongMemEval、LoCoMo和LongLaMP上取得稳定提升。
papers.abstract_en: Long-term memory is essential for personalized agentic systems that interact with users over long time periods, yet current architectures only capture what happened while leaving the reasoning of why it happened to be derived later by underlying LLMs.%, and silo knowledge within individual users. These events can, however, convey not only what a user experienced but also how that experience shaped their behavioral patterns. We introduce STARK, a dual-graph memory architecture which treats these events not just as nodes but also as edges between behavioral insights. STARK maintains an Episodic Graph which records interactions as temporally, causally, and semantically linked episodes; and an Insight Graph which represents LLM-extracted behavioral signals scored by how many events support them, connected by the very events that led to them. At inference, behavioral knowledge is retrieved directly from insight nodes grounded by event-as-edges, eliminating repeated episodic traversal. The event-as-edge structure also naturally enables projecting the knowledge graph into a relational embedding space where cross-user transfer becomes possible under shared contextual circumstances, allowing the system to infer missing insights for cold-start users. Evaluations show that STARK improves by 1.48 judge score on LongMemEval information extraction and 0.93 on LoCoMo open domain questions over state of the art. On the public LongLaMP abstract-generation benchmark, cross-user transfer improves open-ended judge scores by 0.7 points and ROUGE-L by 3 at 5% graph sparsity.

papers.title_en: GenSPARQL: A Generative Extension of SPARQL for Incomplete Knowledge Graphs
papers.authors: Jingcheng Wu, Yi Wang, Hongkuan Zhou, Steffen Staab, Bo Xiong
papers.evidence: 面向知识图谱的LLM增强SPARQL查询与推理
papers.tldr: 知识图谱普遍不完整，而SPARQL只能从已存储的三元组作答，无法利用大语言模型补全缺失事实。为此，GenSPARQL在SPARQL 1.1中引入GENOP算子，在查询求值时将LLM生成的值绑定到查询变量，并通过相似度连接把生成的名字映射到图中的实体IRI。查询规划器仅针对其他图模式和过滤器选出的绑定调用LLM，避免逐绑定重复调用。实验用三个开放权重LLM，嵌入相似度成功映射83%的实体且仅产生一个错误匹配。
papers.abstract_en: Knowledge graphs on the Web are incomplete, and SPARQL answers a query only from the stored triples. Large language models (LLMs) can predict missing facts, but an LLM returns names instead of IRIs and requires one call per binding of a query variable. We present GenSPARQL, a generative extension of SPARQL 1.1 with an operator GENOP that binds values generated by an LLM to query variables during query evaluation. A similarity join maps generated names to entities of the graph, and the query planner invokes the LLM only for the bindings selected by the other graph patterns and filters. In a web workbench, attendees query two graphs built from Wikidata and inspect generated values, mapped entities and LLM calls. In our evaluation with three open-weight LLMs, the embedding similarity maps 83% of the entities named by the LLMs and yields only one incorrect match.
